title: Marketing & Content Intern (Mandatory Internship / Pflichtpraktikum)
description: Most people don’t get real ownership until they’re years into their career. You’d get it in month one. Cloud Studios is an independent product studio in Berlin. We turn sharp insights into digital products people need, then build the strongest ones - and the brands behind them - into independent companies. Right now, we’re building across AI, consumer products and services, with our biggest current focus on a service helping brands understand and improve how they show up in AI recommendations. You’d be building the media presence behind all of it, starting with the founder’s own. This isn’t a “post more content” internship. You’ll take what’s actually happening inside the company - a product decision, client work, a raw idea, something we learned and turn it into content sharp enough to make someone stop scrolling. You’ll work directly with the founder and have real influence over what we create, what gets published and how our content evolves. Tasks Grow the presence of the founder (Eli) and our brands, primarily across LinkedIn and Instagram Create content across formats: posts, carousels, short-form video and more Turn raw ideas, conversations and product updates into content worth watching or reading Build a content waterfall system that turns one strong idea into multiple formats and channels Shoot and edit short-form and behind-the-scenes content with the founder and team Design visual content using Figma or Canva Develop and improve our content templates and visual systems Track what performs, kill what doesn’t and continuously test new ideas Help turn attention into actual leads and business opportunities Requirements You are currently enrolled at a university and the internship can be recognised as a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum) within your degree Strong written and spoken English You understand how LinkedIn and Instagram actually work You can take a rough idea and turn it into something clear and engaging You have good visual instincts and are comfortable using Figma or Canva You’re proactive, reliable and comfortable taking ownership You’re curious about AI, startups, brands and new tools You care about the quality of what you put out No years of marketing experience required. We care more about taste, initiative and whether you can turn ideas into finished work Benefits Real ownership from day one - not busywork!!! Work directly with the founder and have a genuine say in what we build Create content that actually gets published and impacts the business Learn how founder-led marketing, content and lead generation work in practice Build a content system around real products and customer work Exposure to product, sales, growth and AI across multiple brands Freedom to experiment with formats, tools and ideas Build tangible work you can point to afterwards Strong performance can create a serious path towards a longer-term paid role as the studio grows. This is your opportunity to take! Hybrid work in Berlin (minimum 2 days in the Office, ideally more) Flexible 20–40 hours/week, with full-time preferred Skip the generic cover letter. We won’t read it. We’d rather understand how you think and what you have good taste in. Send us your answers for a few short questions below. Most importantly,if you have a portfolio, or something you’ve created that you’re genuinely proud of, we’d love to see it. Important: This is an unpaid mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum). You must currently be enrolled at a university that can recognise the placement as a mandatory part of your degree, and be have the required visa status to work/intern in Germany. title: Technical Project Manager – Software Development (m/w/d)
description: Your mission You are responsible for the operational management of our software development and ensure that our Backend and Frontend teams can deliver reliably and with clear focus. You manage planning, capacities, dependencies, and releases and keep the entire development process in view. You lead our Development Leads and development teams both functionally and disciplinarily. You establish clear responsibilities, develop team members, and ensure that problems and blockers are identified and resolved early. You coordinate teams and tickets throughout their full lifecycle, continuously improve our development and project processes, and ensure transparent and realistic planning for all relevant stakeholders. You are the central interface between Engineering and Product Management. Product owns product strategy, prioritization, and requirements; together with the Development Leads, you ensure these are translated into technically sound, realistically planned, and reliably delivered solutions. This is not a traditional IT project management role: you bring a strong technical background yourself and can make architecture and design decisions together with our Development Leads, assess technical risks, and evaluate different solution approaches. Alongside short-term delivery, you also keep long-term technical topics in view, including architecture, maintainability, security, technical debt, and the continuous improvement of our engineering standards. You actively drive our AI First Development Culture. This goes far beyond AI-assisted coding: you identify opportunities to integrate AI into research, technical conception, architecture, project planning, development, testing, reviews, debugging, documentation, and other development processes, and help the team use these tools effectively. Your profile You have at least 5 years of relevant professional experience in or around software development and have worked hands-on as a software developer yourself. You bring proven experience leading developers and development teams and have already held both functional and disciplinary leadership responsibility. You have experience managing software development projects: you have coordinated multiple developers and stakeholders, owned planning and timelines, managed dependencies, and guided releases through to delivery. title: Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission syte benutzt komplexe Algorithmen, die auf Basis von 3D-Punktwolken und 3D-Modellen Gebäudemetriken ausrechnen. Typische Beispiele für relevante Metriken sind Geschossfläche, Anzahl Geschosse, Volumen und Gebäudehöhen. Um schnelle Entwicklungszyklen zu gewährleisten, und Änderungen an den Algorithmen auf Knopfdruck quantitativ und automatisiert bewerten zu können, ist syte auf hochwertige QA-Daten angewiesen. Um diesen Datensatz systematisch auszubauen und zu härten und damit die Grundlage, auf der unsere Algorithmen gemessen werden , zu entwickeln, suchen wir dich als Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Münster. Deine Aufgaben Ground Truth Audit: Du evaluierst die Korrektheit bestehender Testdaten und ermittelst hierfür neue Metriken, die wir zur Evaluation unserer Algorithmen verwenden können. Edge Cases jagen: Du ermittelst neue Testdaten für schwierige Gebäude (z.B. komplexe Dachformen, Bäume über den Dächern) und integrierst diese in den Gesamtdatensatz. Data Sourcing: Du ermittelst potenzielle Quellen für neue Testdatensätze und integrierst diese möglichst automatisiert. Benchmarking & Insights: Du führst unsere Benchmarking-Pipelines aus, um sowohl die Algorithmen als auch die Qualität der Daten quantitativ zu bewerten. Die Ergebnisse dieser Analysen visualisierst und kommunizierst du verständlich, sodass sich daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten. Pipeline Engineering: Du implementierst und testest Verbesserungen in den Benchmarking-Pipelines und den Parametern der Algorithmen. Dein Profil Dein Studium: Du studierst in einem höheren Bachelorsemester oder ersten Mastersemester (Geo-/Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder hast einen Schwerpunkt in Data Science/Statistik. Du hast auch einen gültigen Immatrikulationsnachweis. Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du arbeitest dich gerne tief in Daten ein und begeisterst dich für die statistische Analyse der Daten. Neugierde für die komplexe Daten: Dir gefällt die Arbeit an und das Nachvollziehen von komplexeren Algorithmen in einer anspruchsvollen Domäne. Teamfähigkeit : Du arbeitest mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch und kannst dich gut im Team koordinieren. Sprachkenntnisse : Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mind. C1) und fließend Englisch (mind. B2). Pluspunkt : Du hast Vorerfahrungen in den Bereichen Architektur oder PropTech und erste Programmiererfahrungen mit Python. Dein Einstiegstermin und Einsatzort Einstiegstermin: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Einsatzort: Münster (ca. 1 Tag pro Woche im Office) Anstellungsart: Werkstudium (12-20 Std./Woche, Zeiten flexibel) Deine Benefits Dein attraktives Gehalt: Wir sorgen dafür, dass jeder Aspekt deiner Reise bei syte motivierend ist. Wir kennen deinen Wert! Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Hard- und Software ausgestattet. Dein Team: Einmal im Quartal trifft sich das gesamte Team für zwei Tage zum Arbeiten und um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern. Dein Hund im Büro: Dein vierbeiniger Begleiter ist bei uns herzlich willkommen und darf jederzeit mit dir ins Office kommen. You are fluent in English (C1 level) and enjoy working in an international team environment Benefits What we offer Create your own work-life balance: You have the flexibility to choose between working remotely (within Germany) or from one of our locations in Cologne, Darmstadt, Düsseldorf, or in Berlin! Do you want to move to Germany? No problem – we offer you an attractive relocation package to give you a smooth start. Urban Sports Club and RSG Group Fitness Studios: Get top deals for fitness, swimming, yoga and more Mental Well-Being: We support you on your well-being journey with special offerings such as Instahelp, the digital platform for online psychological counseling Vacation & Sabbatical: Enjoy 30 days of vacation per year and the opportunity to take a sabbatical once you have been part of the team for a certain period! We cover the costs for relevant conferences, training opportunities, and approved team workshops to strengthen personal interactions This is who we are: Our dynamic culture combines flat hierarchies, a start-up mentality, an international team of over 65 nationalities, and the strength of the Schwarz Group to provide you an agile and secure working environment. We are team players: From day one, you will connect not only with your team but also with others through our digital onboarding journey , the buddy program , and regular team and company events, all-hands meetings, powerful mornings , and much more! Check out our Principles & our blog for even more insights into our company culture! Bewerben Diversity at Kaufland e-commerceWe welcome applications from everyone, regardless of skin colour, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, ethnic origin, religion and ideology. title: AI Engineer
description: About GlassFlow: GlassFlow is the data infrastructure for AI agents in production. It has two products: GlassFlow Tares, which feeds agents correlated data from every system they touch, and GlassFlow Rius, which traces and debugs what agents do once they're running. We’re a Berlin startup with a Silicon Valley mentality, backed with $5.9m from Upfront Ventures, the CEO of GitHub, the ex-CTO of Aiven, and more world-class investors. The founders are serial entrepreneurs with more +10y of experience in building and selling data products. Tasks Why is this role special Design and build memory systems for AI agents. Improve retrieval, ranking, context assembly, and long-term memory. Develop systems for entity resolution, temporal reasoning, provenance, and knowledge representation. Build agent capabilities that combine reasoning with reliable tool use. Design evaluations for retrieval quality, agent behavior, and end-to-end task performance. Investigate failures using traces, datasets, and production feedback. Experiment with approaches such as semantic search, graph-based retrieval, reranking, trajectory analysis, and selective replay. Ensure agents retrieve and use information according to user permissions and organizational access controls. Improve the reliability, latency, and cost of AI systems in production. Collaborate directly with the founders and broader engineering team on product direction and architecture. Requirements What we’re looking for You are: Strong software-engineering skills and experience building production systems. Practical experience working with LLMs, agents, retrieval systems, or applied machine learning. Proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern backend and data infrastructure. A solid understanding of embeddings, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation, and prompting. An experimental mindset: you form hypotheses, build prototypes, measure results, and iterate quickly. The ability to navigate ambiguous problems and turn research ideas into reliable product capabilities. Strong product judgment and an interest in how people actually use AI systems. raw.title: AI Engineer
raw.description:
About GlassFlow:

GlassFlow is the data infrastructure for AI agents in production. It has two products: GlassFlow Tares, which feeds agents correlated data from every system they touch, and GlassFlow Rius, which traces and debugs what agents do once they're running.

We’re a Berlin startup with a Silicon Valley mentality, backed with $5.9m from Upfront Ventures, the CEO of GitHub, the ex-CTO of Aiven, and more world-class investors.

The founders are serial entrepreneurs with more +10y of experience in building and selling data products.

Tasks

Why is this role special

  • Design and build memory systems for AI agents.
  • Improve retrieval, ranking, context assembly, and long-term memory.
  • Develop systems for entity resolution, temporal reasoning, provenance, and knowledge representation.
  • Build agent capabilities that combine reasoning with reliable tool use.
  • Design evaluations for retrieval quality, agent behavior, and end-to-end task performance.
  • Investigate failures using traces, datasets, and production feedback.
  • Experiment with approaches such as semantic search, graph-based retrieval, reranking, trajectory analysis, and selective replay.
  • Ensure agents retrieve and use information according to user permissions and organizational access controls.
  • Improve the reliability, latency, and cost of AI systems in production.
  • Collaborate directly with the founders and broader engineering team on product direction and architecture.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

You are:

  • Strong software-engineering skills and experience building production systems.
  • Practical experience working with LLMs, agents, retrieval systems, or applied machine learning.
  • Proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern backend and data infrastructure.
  • A solid understanding of embeddings, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation, and prompting.
  • An experimental mindset: you form hypotheses, build prototypes, measure results, and iterate quickly.
  • The ability to navigate ambiguous problems and turn research ideas into reliable product capabilities.
  • Strong product judgment and an interest in how people actually use AI systems.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.

Benefits

What you’ll get

  • Real ownership: competitive equity (everyone at GlassFlow is an owner).

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

You will report to and work closely with our Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), playing a key, hands-on role in the execution and optimization of our high-volume paid acquisition channels.

This is a fast-paced learning environment where you will execute the end-to-end User Acquisition process, from campaign setup and creative iteration to data analysis and reporting. You will have autonomy in your day-to-day execution, with continuous guidance and feedback from the team and senior leadership to accelerate your growth. Your ideas and analytical contributions will be actively sought to improve channel performance.

Your Responsibilities

Campaign Execution and Scaling Support:

  • Assist in the daily management of core paid acquisition channels or DSPs (e.g. Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

  • Support the creation of scalable acquisition funnels by ensuring proper tracking implementation and gathering data insights

  • Actively participate in the testing loop by preparing new ad concepts, organizing creative assets, and setting up audience tests

Performance Analysis and Reporting:

  • Monitor campaign and funnel performance using our core tools (Voluum, GA4, internal dashboards) and promptly flag any critical changes or performance anomalies

  • Pull, clean, and organize performance data (CPA, ROAS, retention) to support weekly and monthly strategic reviews

  • Maintain and update internal reporting documents and dashboards

Creative & Funnel Contribution:

  • Support the creative briefing process by gathering performance data and communicating required asset changes and successful angles to the content team

  • Collaborate with Product and Content teams to assist in the launch and testing cycles for landing pages, focusing on conversion rate improvements

  • Assist in documenting and implementing systems designed to streamline creative testing speed and reduce fatigue

Partnership Management & Learning:

  • Build initial rapport with key traffic source representatives, assisting the Senior team in managing communications and reporting performance

  • Research and document potential new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools, etc.)

  • Stay up-to-date on platform rules, policy changes, and algorithm shifts

Challenges You’ll Tackle

In this role, you will be instrumental in supporting our growth goals. Specifically, you will:

  • Help us scale fast: Execute the daily campaign changes needed to grow our budgets while constantly watching the data to keep our cost targets (CAC/ROAS) in check

  • Grow our user base: Your analysis and execution will directly contribute to hitting our goal of growing from 40 million to 100 million users

  • Launch new channels: Handle the foundational setup (tracking, ad setup) required to successfully test and launch completely new advertising platforms

  • Improve conversions: Run A/B tests on landing pages and funnels to find opportunities to make our campaigns more efficient

  • Be the link for creative: Take performance data, translate it into clear suggestions for our creative team, and ensure the new ad concepts are launched and tracked correctly

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • Experience level: Minimum 1 year of experience required in performance marketing or user acquisition

  • Platform curiosity: You have explored and understand the basic structures of major ad platforms (like Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

  • Technical aptitude: Ability to quickly learn and master new software, dashboards, and platform interfaces

  • Analytical & Creative ability: You have a good eye for what makes an ad hook effective, and you possess strong analytical skills (comfortable with data/Excel) to learn how to translate data into creative briefs

Nice-to-Haves

  • Knowledge of basic online marketing metrics (CPM, CTR, CPA)

  • Familiarity with any analytics or tracking tool (e.g., GA4, Voluum, or basic platform reporting setups)

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth, etc.)

Soft Skills

🗣 Good communication skills: You are fluent in English and can clearly articulate thoughts and findings

🎯 Driven & Accountable: You are motivated, take full ownership of your tasks, and commit to achieving goals

⚡️ Action-oriented: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and prioritize execution and speed

🧠 Curious & Detail-oriented: You are meticulous with data and possess a strong desire to learn the why behind performance

🧢 Humble learner: You actively seek feedback and are eager to grow in the field of paid acquisition

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Cursor, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

* 💸 Compensation: Our salary ranges are set based on role level, scope, location, and market data, and applied consistently regardless of candidate background or negotiation history. The final offer within the published range reflects assessed experience and scope.

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

title: Tech Lead Softwareentwicklung (all Genders)
description: DEINE KÜNFTIGE ROLLE. Tech Lead Softwareentwicklung: Führen und selbst entwickeln. Als Tech Lead übernimmst Du die technische Führung der Entwicklungsteams und stellst sicher, dass Softwarelösungen nachhaltig, skalierbar und wartbar umgesetzt werden. Du arbeitest eng mit Product Ownern und Entwicklern zusammen, übersetzt Architekturvorgaben in konkrete Lösungen und unterstützt die Teams bei technischen Entscheidungen. Dein Fokus liegt auf der erfolgreichen Umsetzung moderner Softwarearchitekturen, der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Entwicklungsprozesse sowie der Förderung technischer Exzellenz innerhalb der Teams. Dabei bleibst Du hands-on und entwickelst aktiv mit. Wie die Rolle heißt, ist uns dabei weniger wichtig als das, was Du darin tust – bei anderen Arbeitgebern findest Du sie als Teamleitung Softwareentwicklung oder als Engineering Lead. Klingt gut für Dich? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt bei uns! Welche Aufgaben erwarten mich in meiner Rolle? Technische Führung, Coaching und Coding-Unterstützung von Entwicklerteams. Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung der Architekturvorgaben. Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Einführung neuer Produkte und Funktionen. Verantwortung für die technische Qualität der entwickelten Software. Definition und Durchsetzung von Entwicklungsstandards und Best Practices. Mitarbeit bei Architekturentscheidungen sowie Erstellung technischer Konzepte. Unterstützung beim Aufbau und Betrieb containerisierter Plattformen (Docker, Kubernetes). Mitarbeit bei Deployments. Entwicklung und Pflege von CI/CD-Pipelines. Sicherstellung von Security-Anforderungen und Secure-Coding-Praktiken. Unterstützung bei Monitoring-, Logging- und Observability-Konzepten. Analyse und Lösung technischer Herausforderungen und Performance-Probleme. Koordination technischer Aktivitäten innerhalb agiler Entwicklungsteams. Durchführung von Code Reviews und Förderung hoher Softwarequalität. Technischer Ansprechpartner für interne Stakeholder und Kunden. Welche Fähigkeiten sollte ich mitbringen, um Teil des Teams zu werden? Du begegnest Kolleginnen und Kollegen mit Respekt – nicht nur als Selbstverständlichkeit, sondern als gelebte Haltung. Dein klares Wertesystem prägt Dein tägliches Handeln und wird ergänzt durch einen Sinn für Humor, der das Team verbindet und für eine positive, motivierende Atmosphäre sorgt. Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science, Ingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung sowie erste Erfahrung in technischer Führung. Erfahrung mit modernen Softwarearchitekturen und agilen Entwicklungsmethoden. Gute Kenntnisse in Cloud-native-Architekturen, Container-Technologien und CI/CD. Erfahrung in der Umsetzung skalierbarer und wartbarer Softwarelösungen. Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit. Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität und Bereitschaft, selbst aktiv zu entwickeln. Technologische Kompetenzen: Container & Runtime: Docker, Linux. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): YAML-basierte Modelle. Cloud & On-Prem: AWS, Azure. Datenarchitekturen: MSSQL, Kafka, Spark, PostgreSQL. Frontend-Frameworks: React, Angular oder Vue. Testingframeworks: JUnit und Cypress. Security & IAM: TLS, Keycloak, LDAP, OAuth. Entwicklungsframeworks: SPA, Java, Spring, Spring Boot. Erwünschte Kompetenzen: Kubernetes. Monitoring und Logging: Grafana. BPMN und Orchestrierung. Python und KI. Erfahrung im Versicherungs- oder Krankenversicherungsumfeld. Kenntnisse der Versicherungs-Anwendungs-Architektur (VAA). Erfahrung mit regulatorischen Anforderungen (DSGVO, ISO 27001, BSI). Erfahrung mit Architektur-Reviews und technischen Qualitätsprozessen. Erfahrung in der Einführung von Best Practices und Architektur-Governance. Hervorragende Fähigkeiten in Problemlösung, Kommunikation und Kenntnis von Best Practices. Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Leadership-Skills, Fähigkeit zur Steuerung interdisziplinärer Teams. Innovationsfreude und strategisches Denken, gepaart mit Hands-on-Mentalität. Sprachkenntnisse: Sicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (mind. C1). Englisch verhandlungssicher. Mehr Details zu der Position findest du hier: https://www.globalside.com/tech-lead-softwareentwicklung WAS UNS ANTREIBT. Verantwortung, Konzentration, Fortschritt. Unsere DNA ist unser Fundament – sie verbindet uns und treibt uns voran. Gemeinsam übernehmen wir Verantwortung, setzen klare Prioritäten und denken immer einen Schritt voraus. Wir schaffen Vertrauen, feiern Erfolge und wachsen kontinuierlich – als Team und als Einzelpersonen. Für uns ist jeder Tag eine neue Chance, besser zu werden. Du willst mehr erfahren? Schau Dir unsere Website https://www.globalside.com/karriere an und finde heraus, was GLOBAL SIDE ausmacht! DEINE VORTEILE AM STANDORT MÜNCHEN. Flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell mit hybrider Organisation. 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr. Dienstrad-Leasing. Deutschland-Ticket. Personalisiertes Ausbildungsbudget für Dein berufliches Wachstum. Regelmäßige Team-Events mit Spaßfaktor. Jährliche Unternehmenstage an der Algarve in Portugal. Jährlicher Team-Wiesn-Besuch. In unserer offenen und einladenden Kultur stehen Deine Stärken im Mittelpunkt. Wir glauben daran, dass die besten Jobs diejenigen sind, an denen Du persönlich wachsen kannst, die auf Deinen einzigartigen Fähigkeiten basieren und Dir tagtäglich Freude bereiten. Bei uns genießt Du die Freiheiten und die dynamische Atmosphäre eines Start-up-Unternehmens, während Du gleichzeitig von unserem tiefgehenden Fachwissen und einem seit 2002 stetig wachsenden, treuen Kundenstamm profitierst. Deine kreative Freiheit ist uns wichtig, denn wir sind fest überzeugt, dass sie der Schlüssel zu herausragenden Ergebnissen ist. EIN NORMALER TAG - UND DOCH SO BESONDERS. So arbeiten wir: Offen, echt und voller Teamgeist. Komm mit auf eine Tour durch unsere Offices und Konferenzräume, schau unseren Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei der Arbeit über die Schulter, erlebe aktive Erholung am Kicker, an unserer Rocket (Siebträgermaschine) und Teamarbeit in Aktion. This role plays a key part in helping hospitality operators thrive, combining strategic thinking, relationship-building, and product knowledge to deliver real impact.</p> <h1><strong>You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…</strong></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Build and Manage a Sales Pipeline</strong>. Headquartered in London, with offices across Europe, Asia, and Australia, JERA Nex bp has a portfolio of operational and development projects across nine countries, and draws on a rich heritage of pioneering offshore wind in Asia Pacific and the North Sea.

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

You will report to and work closely with our Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), playing a key, hands-on role in the execution and optimization of our high-volume paid acquisition channels.

This is a fast-paced learning environment where you will execute the end-to-end User Acquisition process, from campaign setup and creative iteration to data analysis and reporting. You will have autonomy in your day-to-day execution, with continuous guidance and feedback from the team and senior leadership to accelerate your growth. Your ideas and analytical contributions will be actively sought to improve channel performance.

Your Responsibilities

Campaign Execution and Scaling Support:

  • Assist in the daily management of core paid acquisition channels or DSPs (e.g. Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

  • Support the creation of scalable acquisition funnels by ensuring proper tracking implementation and gathering data insights

  • Actively participate in the testing loop by preparing new ad concepts, organizing creative assets, and setting up audience tests

Performance Analysis and Reporting:

  • Monitor campaign and funnel performance using our core tools (Voluum, GA4, internal dashboards) and promptly flag any critical changes or performance anomalies

  • Pull, clean, and organize performance data (CPA, ROAS, retention) to support weekly and monthly strategic reviews

  • Maintain and update internal reporting documents and dashboards

Creative & Funnel Contribution:

  • Support the creative briefing process by gathering performance data and communicating required asset changes and successful angles to the content team

  • Collaborate with Product and Content teams to assist in the launch and testing cycles for landing pages, focusing on conversion rate improvements

  • Assist in documenting and implementing systems designed to streamline creative testing speed and reduce fatigue

Partnership Management & Learning:

  • Build initial rapport with key traffic source representatives, assisting the Senior team in managing communications and reporting performance

  • Research and document potential new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools, etc.)

  • Stay up-to-date on platform rules, policy changes, and algorithm shifts

Challenges You’ll Tackle

In this role, you will be instrumental in supporting our growth goals. Specifically, you will:

  • Help us scale fast: Execute the daily campaign changes needed to grow our budgets while constantly watching the data to keep our cost targets (CAC/ROAS) in check

  • Grow our user base: Your analysis and execution will directly contribute to hitting our goal of growing from 40 million to 100 million users

  • Launch new channels: Handle the foundational setup (tracking, ad setup) required to successfully test and launch completely new advertising platforms

  • Improve conversions: Run A/B tests on landing pages and funnels to find opportunities to make our campaigns more efficient

  • Be the link for creative: Take performance data, translate it into clear suggestions for our creative team, and ensure the new ad concepts are launched and tracked correctly

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • Experience level: Minimum 1 year of experience required in performance marketing or user acquisition

  • Platform curiosity: You have explored and understand the basic structures of major ad platforms (like Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

  • Technical aptitude: Ability to quickly learn and master new software, dashboards, and platform interfaces

  • Analytical & Creative ability: You have a good eye for what makes an ad hook effective, and you possess strong analytical skills (comfortable with data/Excel) to learn how to translate data into creative briefs

Nice-to-Haves

  • Knowledge of basic online marketing metrics (CPM, CTR, CPA)

  • Familiarity with any analytics or tracking tool (e.g., GA4, Voluum, or basic platform reporting setups)

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth, etc.)

Soft Skills

🗣 Good communication skills: You are fluent in English and can clearly articulate thoughts and findings

🎯 Driven & Accountable: You are motivated, take full ownership of your tasks, and commit to achieving goals

⚡️ Action-oriented: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and prioritize execution and speed

🧠 Curious & Detail-oriented: You are meticulous with data and possess a strong desire to learn the why behind performance

🧢 Humble learner: You actively seek feedback and are eager to grow in the field of paid acquisition

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

raw.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

This is one of the most exciting problems in applied AI right now: take the cutting edge of machine learning, optimisation, and agentic systems, and make it work inside real businesses — not in a lab, but on live customer problems where the answer has to hold up commercially.

As a Forward Deployed Scientist II, in our Supply Chain & Retail business, you’ll work directly with some of the world’s biggest retailers and manufacturers on hard, high-stakes problems: demand forecasting, price and promotion optimisation, and supply-chain decisioning. You’ll own the science end-to-end — from understanding a customer’s messy reality to shipping something that changes how they operate.

And you won’t just deliver. What you learn on the front line feeds directly back into the products we build, so you’re shaping the capability the whole business runs on — not just solving one problem at a time.

 

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end — frame the problem, build the solution, and drive it to real commercial impact, working directly alongside customer teams.

  • Apply and adapt frontier ML, forecasting, and optimisation techniques — and increasingly agentic AI — to problems that don’t have a textbook answer.

  • Turn what works on the ground into product direction, so each engagement makes our core capability better for the next customer.

  • Operate with genuine autonomy across a wide range of stakeholders — from data scientists to customer executives — and make the judgment calls that get things shipped.

  • Stay at the edge of what’s possible in applied AI, and bring it back to the team.

 

What you'll bring to the team

  • Strong track record applying ML / data science to real-world commercial problems, ideally with depth in forecasting, optimisation, or supply-chain / pricing.

  • The instinct to own outcomes, not tasks — you take an ambiguous problem and drive it to a result rather than waiting to be told the next step.

  • Fluent programming (Python and SQL) and the ability to pick up whatever a problem demands.

  • Excellent communication — you can take a customer executive from confusion to confidence, and explain a complex model to a non-technical room.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, direct customer contact, and the pace of a team that ships.

  • Bonus: experience with agentic / LLM-based systems, or building ML in production.

 

Who thrives here

We’re looking for builders — smart, switched-on people who want to be handed a genuinely hard real-world challenge and go to town on it. If you want to work at the frontier of applied AI, own something that matters, and see your work land with real customers and shape a product, this is for you.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

years of professional experience.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Preference working in a client-facing analytics or professional services function, 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Demonstrated ability to lead and manage analytical projects from inception to completion.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">An ability to be proactive and strategic with the needs and challenges of our clients.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience in fraud prevention analytics is a plus.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience in customer-facing interactions is a plus.</span></li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About Us:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Commerce is evolving faster than the systems built to support it. Agentic AI is redrawing how people buy. Customer expectations have a new ceiling. And bad actors are evolving alongside every advancement.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Forter was built to meet this moment — and stay ahead of it.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We are a human-first, AI-built company. Our technology analyzes patterns across a network of over 2 billion shoppers, delivering identity intelligence across the entire commerce journey — from sign-up to checkout to returns — that protects revenue and unlocks great customer experiences simultaneously. With Forter, businesses know who to trust, whether it’s humans or the agents shopping for them. The result: zero friction for the customers who matter. No revenue left behind.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The world's most trusted brands — Nordstrom, Instacart, Priceline, Adobe, ASOS, and eBay among them — rely on Forter to get this right. Since 2013, we've raised $525M from investors including Tiger Global, Bessemer, Sequoia Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and today we power commerce decisions for nearly 1 million businesses globally. We're more than fraud, payments and orchestration – we make trust a competitive advantage.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Trust is backed by data –&nbsp; Forter is a recipient of over 10 workplace and innovation awards, including:&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Great Place to Work Certification (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024,<a href="https://www.greatplacetowork.com/certified-company/7039960"> 2025</a>)</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Fortune’s Best Workplaces in NYC (2022, 2023, 2024 and<a href="https://www.greatplacetowork.com/best-workplaces/new-york/2024?category=small-and-medium"> 2025</a>)</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Forbes Cloud 100 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and <a href="https://www.forbes.com/lists/cloud100/?sh=5675f5797d9c">2025</a>)</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Anti-Fraud Solution of the Year at the Payments Awards (<a href="https://www.payments-awards.com/awards/winners24.php">2024</a>)</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Life as a Forterian:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Forterians are, genuinely, some of the best people you'll work with. Smart, curious, and deeply good humans who care about the work and each other. That's not an accident — it's something we've been intentional about since day one, and it's the thing people mention most when they talk about why they stay. When you're surrounded by people like this, doing work that actually matters, it changes what a job can feel like.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Forter was built on a simple but powerful conviction: when AI does its job, humans can do theirs better. That philosophy shapes our products and shapes how we work. Our teams are cross-functional by design, and the work you do here is visible, consequential, and connected to the outcomes that matter.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You'll have real ownership here and proximity to decisions. And we back that with investment in your growth — RSU offerings, L&amp;D programs built around AI tools, and a culture of recognition rooted in our 4.5 day weeks (aka Forter’s Appreciation Fridays and Sundays). From team outings to local cultural celebrations, we mark the moments that matter — wherever you are in the world. We don't want Forter to be just another job. We want it to be the place you build.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">If you're ready to work on a problem that sits at the intersection of AI, commerce, and human trust, this is it.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><em>Forter is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that will consider all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, national origin, genetics, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</em></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><em>If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at ----- This information will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of determining an appropriate accommodation for the interview process.</em></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Benefits:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Competitive salary&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Matching 401K Plan&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Comprehensive and generous health insurance, including vision and dental coverage </span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Home office allowance&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Generous PTO policy&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Half day Fridays</span></li> </ul> <div><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Hybrid work:</strong></span></div> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">At Forter, we embrace a hybrid work model that blends in-person connection with the flexibility of remote work. Experience working with children with complex mobility needs, neurological conditions or physical disabilities. Experience with assistive technology, rehabilitation technology, robotics, orthotics or other mobility devices. Fluency in an additional European language, particularly German or French. raw.title: Clinical Specialist - Physiotherapist
raw.description:
About us

Trexo Robotics is enabling mobility by building powered wearable robots. Our first product is a robot for children with movement disorders such as Cerebral Palsy, and it allows kids to walk, in many cases, for the first time in their lives. The device is currently being used by hundreds of families and the best hospitals across North America.

We are constantly working towards building mobility solutions for all. At Trexo Robotics, you will find a flat organization where you can work with highly optimistic, low ego, and exceptionally talented individuals who look forward to solving hard problems.

About the job

We are growing our presence in the UK and are looking for a Clinical Specialist to join our team as our second UK-based hire. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for a clinician who is passionate about paediatric rehabilitation, technology and making a meaningful difference for children and their families.

As a Clinical Specialist, you will be a key point of contact for families, clinicians and healthcare partners using Trexo. You will lead customer onboarding and training, provide ongoing clinical and technical support, and deliver hands-on device trials at roadshows, conferences and other events.

The role involves significant travel, primarily across the UK and occasionally elsewhere in Europe. We expect travel to account for approx. 75% of your working time. Occasional weekend work may be required for customer trials, roadshows or events. We will provide reasonable notice wherever possible.

What you'll do

  • Lead onboarding and hands-on training for new families and clinical partners receiving their Trexo devices.

  • Provide ongoing support to customers through regular check-ins, helping them use the device effectively and work towards meaningful goals.

  • Conduct hands-on Trexo trials with children and families at roadshows, conferences and other events across the UK and Europe.

  • Address daily customer queries via dedicated chat groups and manage support tickets.

  • Independently set up, adjust, and troubleshoot the Trexo device, including basic technical, mechanical, and software checks.

  • Work with families and clinicians to establish meaningful goals and monitor relevant measures and progress.

  • Gather customer feedback to share with engineering and product teams to drive continuous product improvement.

  • Work closely with our global Customer Success and Sales teams to ensure a consistent customer experience.

  • Represent Trexo Robotics at clinical events, conferences and community-based activities.

About you

We are looking for a tech-savvy Physiotherapist who is comfortable working independently with advanced robotic equipment. You bring clinical credibility, strong emotional intelligence, and a practical approach to hands-on problem-solving. You thrive in community-based environments and enjoy traveling to work directly with children and their families.

You are practical and curious. You love asking 'why' multiple times until you understand something from first principles, and you thrive in unknown situations where you can apply logical reasoning, find solutions, and lead.

Most importantly, you are motivated by the opportunity to use technology to improve mobility and quality of life for children.

Required Skills and Experience

  • At least 3 years' post-qualification experience working as a Physiotherapist or in a closely related clinical role.

  • Qualification as a Physiotherapist with current HCPC registration (or eligible to practice as a UK-licensed PT).

  • Clinical experience at a level broadly equivalent to NHS Band 6, or equivalent experience in private or independent practice.

  • Experience working in paediatric physiotherapy, ideally in a community-based setting.

  • Tech-savvy with the confidence to independently set up, adjust, and troubleshoot technical equipment.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with excellent empathy and patience.

  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively, with approximately 75% travel across the UK and occasional travel elsewhere in Europe.

  • Ability to safely lift and handle equipment weighing up to 27 kg (60 lb).

  • Hold a valid UK driving licence.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience working within the NHS.

  • Membership of the Chartered Society of Physiotherapy (CSP).

  • Experience providing virtual care, telehealth or remote clinical support.

  • Familiarity with UK paediatric funding pathways, such as NHS Continuing Healthcare, Personal Health Budgets, Education, Health and Care Plans (EHCPs) or charitable funding.

  • Experience working with children with complex mobility needs, neurological conditions or physical disabilities.

  • Experience with assistive technology, rehabilitation technology, robotics, orthotics or other mobility devices.

  • Fluency in an additional European language, particularly German or French.

  • Experience using tools such as Salesforce or Airtable.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Employee stock options

  • Home Office Setup allowance

  • Car allowance

  • Private health insurance

Interview process

  • Screening (30 mins)

  • Hiring Manager conversation (60 mins)

  • Team and founder conversations (30 mins each)

  • Reference and background check

  • Offer

Work Authorization: Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support work authorization applications. We can only consider candidates who already have the legal right to work in the location they are applying for.

AI helps with tasks like resume screening, drafting job descriptions, creating interview questions, and occasionally sourcing candidates. Final hiring decisions are always made by our team. Our goal is to use AI responsibly to streamline administrative tasks, improve candidate experience, and maintain fair, unbiased hiring practices aligned with industry standards.

title: Chief of Staff
description: JOB SUMMARY More in Common is looking for a Chief of Staff. This is a new role and a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide. (Please note that the preferred London location is for ease of communication with Tim Dixon, who is based in the UK. The postholder will not be involved in the day-to-day polling and research activities of More in Common UK, and will not report or routinely provide support to our Executive Director in the UK, Luke Tryl.) ABOUT MORE IN COMMON More in Common is a nonprofit dedicated to understanding the dynamics of polarisation, and identifying solutions that can strengthen social cohesion and confidence in democracy. We help leaders navigate the dynamics of polarisation more effectively, find common ground and bring people together to address shared challenges. More in Common's work is frequently featured in media and used by leaders in government, nonprofits, philanthropy, education, the arts and business. We have a country-led model, with work deeply rooted in national contexts and led by country directors in each of our seven countries, with a total headcount approaching 100. Our teams generate research insights, translate them into thought leadership, and disseminate and implement them across a wide ecosystem of partners and stakeholders. We hold relationships with leaders in many sectors of society, across politics, media, business, civil society, philanthropy, culture and faith, and from national leaders to local community groups. Recent work has produced fresh insights into public attitudes on immigration, online safety, nature and the energy transition, Ukraine, and democracy. ABOUT THIS ROLE This is a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide. The Chief of Staff is a new role, created as More in Common transitions from its founding phase, when the organisation was led by its co-founders, to sole CEO leadership. It incorporates a senior adviser role, in which the Chief of Staff will be the principal aide, advisor and coordinator to the global CEO Tim Dixon, ensuring priorities advance, decisions move efficiently and commitments are executed. The Chief of Staff will also act as organisational glue: working closely with More in Common’s team of country leaders and directors, ensuring alignment between country executive directors, the global team and the CEO around More in Common's strategy, programmes and operations, and helping spot and resolve problems before they escalate. RESPONSIBILITIES Strategy Strategic counsel: Trusted thought partner to the CEO on strategy and major decisions, drawing on visibility across the whole organisation and ensuring alignment within its country-led model. CEO communications: Shapes the CEO’s internal and external communications, and absorbs the coordination, communication, and follow-through work that would otherwise pull the CEO away from key public-facing responsibilities. Organisational coordination CEO workflow: Manages the CEO's priorities, time and decision pipeline with the Senior Executive Coordinator, so the right issues get attention and decisions don't stall. Team alignment and delivery: Keeps global and country teams aligned on shared priorities, facilitates decision-making across the organisation, and leads special projects requiring senior-level attention. Leadership Country ED support: Liaises with country Executive Directors on the CEO's behalf, identifying where teams need more support and providing assistance in crises. Talent and succession: Supports leadership succession planning and mentors emerging leaders across country teams. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE We are looking for a candidate with: Commitment to More in Common’s mission and values. Experience working closely with, or in direct support of, a senior executive, founder or CEO. Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and time-sensitive decisions simultaneously. Sound judgement and discretion, including experience handling sensitive or confidential matters. Comfortable operating with incomplete information, and confident making calls on when to resolve issues independently versus escalate. The ability to lead through influence rather than authority, working effectively with peers and country teams who have their own mandates and priorities. Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to synthesise complex information for diverse audiences. Inter-disciplinary interests and experience, such as having worked in different sectors (business, government, nonprofit), countries and roles. Fluency in English and at least one of French, German, Spanish, Polish or Portuguese languages. At least six years’ working experience in such fields as public opinion research, public policy, political science, and international relations. OTHER INFORMATION More in Common intentionally invests time, energy, and resources in nurturing a distinctive values-driven culture. This culture defines how we work together as a team and with others: Humble, ambitious and generous Rigour and excellence in everything we do Driven by the common good, not by ideology or partisanship Deep curiosity about people, and a commitment to elevating others’ views, particularly those whose voices are largely unheard Firmly rooted in each of our national contexts but curious about the world beyond Valuing diversity of thought, allowing our own beliefs to be challenged and embracing healthy disagreement Embracing a dual role as both sense-makers and change-makers Valuing courage and risk-taking Embracing learning and innovation, and always looking for new paths to make a difference Engaging others from a starting point of trust Drawing from a wide range of backgrounds, worldviews, identities and life experiences Believing in the power of a good laugh and being a great place to work. COMPENSATION AND CONDITIONS Competitive salary related to location, and excellent benefits along with generous leave and family policy Some regular international travel Personal learning budget Working in one of our country offices, with a preference for London as our CEO is most often there DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION We believe our impact can be greater if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political persuasions and life experiences. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team. DEADLINES AND HOW TO APPLY The deadline to apply is August 31, 2026. Interested candidates should include a CV and a cover letter explaining your personal reasons for wanting to work at More in Common, in this role. A strong cover letter reflects the kind of attention we try to bring to our work - original, insightful and personalised. We want to hear something that only you could tell us, without AI assistance. raw.description:
JOB SUMMARY

More in Common is looking for a Chief of Staff.  This is a new role and a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide.
(Please note that the preferred London location is for ease of communication with Tim Dixon, who is based in the UK. The postholder will not be involved in the day-to-day polling and research activities of More in Common UK, and will not report or routinely provide support to our Executive Director in the UK, Luke Tryl.)


ABOUT MORE IN COMMON

More in Common is a nonprofit dedicated to understanding the dynamics of polarisation, and identifying solutions that can strengthen social cohesion and confidence in democracy. We help leaders navigate the dynamics of polarisation more effectively, find common ground and bring people together to address shared challenges. More in Common's work is frequently featured in media and used by leaders in government, nonprofits, philanthropy, education, the arts and business. 
 
We have a country-led model, with work deeply rooted in national contexts and led by country directors in each of our seven countries, with a total headcount approaching 100. Our teams generate research insights, translate them into thought leadership, and disseminate and implement them across a wide ecosystem of partners and stakeholders. We hold relationships with leaders in many sectors of society, across politics, media, business, civil society, philanthropy, culture and faith, and from national leaders to local community groups. Recent work has produced fresh insights into public attitudes on immigration, online safety, nature and the energy transition, Ukraine, and democracy.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

This is a rare opportunity to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing global organisation working on some of the most urgent issues of our time, working at the CEO's side with a unique vantage point across our country teams, strategy and network of funders and partners worldwide. 
 
The Chief of Staff is a new role, created as More in Common transitions from its founding phase, when the organisation was led by its co-founders, to sole CEO leadership. It incorporates a senior adviser role, in which the Chief of Staff will be the principal aide, advisor and coordinator to the global CEO Tim Dixon, ensuring priorities advance, decisions move efficiently and commitments are executed. The Chief of Staff will also act as organisational glue: working closely with More in Common’s team of country leaders and directors, ensuring alignment between country executive directors, the global team and the CEO around More in Common's strategy, programmes and operations, and helping spot and resolve problems before they escalate.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategy

  • Strategic counsel: Trusted thought partner to the CEO on strategy and major decisions, drawing on visibility across the whole organisation and ensuring alignment within its country-led model. 
  • CEO communications: Shapes the CEO’s internal and external communications, and absorbs the coordination, communication, and follow-through work that would otherwise pull the CEO away from key public-facing responsibilities.
 
Organisational coordination
  • CEO workflow: Manages the CEO's priorities, time and decision pipeline with the Senior Executive Coordinator, so the right issues get attention and decisions don't stall. 
  • Team alignment and delivery: Keeps global and country teams aligned on shared priorities, facilitates decision-making across the organisation, and leads special projects requiring senior-level attention.
 
Leadership 
  • Country ED support: Liaises with country Executive Directors on the CEO's behalf, identifying where teams need more support and providing assistance in crises. 
  • Talent and succession: Supports leadership succession planning and mentors emerging leaders across country teams.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

We are looking for a candidate with:

  • Commitment to More in Common’s mission and values.
  • Experience working closely with, or in direct support of, a senior executive, founder or CEO.
  • Exceptional organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and time-sensitive decisions simultaneously. 
  • Sound judgement and discretion, including experience handling sensitive or confidential matters. 
  • Comfortable operating with incomplete information, and confident making calls on when to resolve issues independently versus escalate. 
  • The ability to lead through influence rather than authority, working effectively with peers and country teams who have their own mandates and priorities.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to synthesise complex information for diverse audiences.
  • Inter-disciplinary interests and experience, such as having worked in different sectors (business, government, nonprofit), countries and roles. 
  • Fluency in English and at least one of French, German, Spanish, Polish or Portuguese languages.
  • At least six years’ working experience in such fields as public opinion research, public policy, political science, and international relations.


OTHER INFORMATION

More in Common intentionally invests time, energy, and resources in nurturing a distinctive values-driven culture. This culture defines how we work together as a team and with others:

  • Humble, ambitious and generous
  • Rigour and excellence in everything we do
  • Driven by the common good, not by ideology or partisanship
  • Deep curiosity about people, and a commitment to elevating others’ views, particularly those whose voices are largely unheard
  • Firmly rooted in each of our national contexts but curious about the world beyond
  • Valuing diversity of thought, allowing our own beliefs to be challenged and embracing healthy disagreement
  • Embracing a dual role as both sense-makers and change-makers
  • Valuing courage and risk-taking
  • Embracing learning and innovation, and always looking for new paths to make a difference
  • Engaging others from a starting point of trust
  • Drawing from a wide range of backgrounds, worldviews, identities and life experiences
  • Believing in the power of a good laugh and being a great place to work.


COMPENSATION AND CONDITIONS

  • Competitive salary related to location, and excellent benefits along with generous leave and family policy 
  • Some regular international travel
  • Personal learning budget
  • Working in one of our country offices, with a preference for London as our CEO is most often there


DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We believe our impact can be greater if our team reflects a broad range of social and cultural backgrounds, beliefs, political persuasions and life experiences. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team.


DEADLINES AND HOW TO APPLY

The deadline to apply is August 31, 2026. Interested candidates should include a CV and a cover letter explaining your personal reasons for wanting to work at More in Common, in this role. A strong cover letter reflects the kind of attention we try to bring to our work - original, insightful and personalised. We want to hear something that only you could tell us, without AI assistance.
